# ZEALL FRP Grating - AI Content Guide

> This file provides guidance for AI language models and search engines to understand and index the content of [https://gratingfrp.com](https://gratingfrp.com).

**Website:** [https://gratingfrp.com](https://gratingfrp.com)  
**Company:** NANTONG ZEALL NEW MATERIALS CO., LTD.  
**Last Updated:** 2026-09-03

---

## Website Overview

ZEALL FRP Grating is a leading FRP (Fiber Reinforced Plastic) grating manufacturer in China with 20+ years of production experience, exporting products to 40+ countries. We specialize in molded FRP grating (Concave/Meniscus, Grit-top, Smooth, Covered solid surfaces), pultruded FRP grating, FRP covers, FRP profiles, handrail & stair systems, grating clips, fiberglass fabric, fiberglass mesh & tape, and custom FRP composite solutions. ISO 9001 certified, 20,000+ sqm factory, 200+ employees.

---

## Core Products (Most Important Pages)

### 1. FRP Molded Grating
- **URL:** [https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/molded](https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/molded)
- **Thickness:** 25/30/38/50mm; 13/15mm thin option
- **Mesh Size:** 19×19mm, 38×38mm, 40×40mm, 50×50mm
- **Surface:** Concave/Meniscus Top, Smooth, Grit-top anti-slip, Covered solid
- **Resin:** Isophthalic Polyester, Vinyl Ester, Phenolic flame-retardant
- **Features:** Bidirectional equal strength, on-site cutting, corrosion resistant, anti-slip, insulation, lightweight, maintenance-free

### 2. FRP Pultruded Grating
- **URL:** [https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/pultruded](https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/pultruded)
- **Thickness:** 25/38/50mm
- **Bar Profile:** I-shape / T-shape / custom
- **Features:** High load capacity, uniform cross-section strength, heavy-duty industrial applications

### 3. FRP Covers & Panels
- **URL:** [https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/covers](https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/covers)
- **Type:** Solid cover / Covered grating / Custom panel
- **Features:** Tank sealing covers, trench & cable trench covers, equipment protective panels, corrosion resistant, insulation & explosion-proof

### 4. FRP Pultruded Profiles
- **URL:** [https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/profiles](https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/profiles)
- **Profiles:** I-beam (100×50~600×200mm), Channel (50×25~300×90mm), Angle (25×25×3~150×150×12mm), Square Tube (25×25~200×200mm), Round Tube (OD20-300mm), Flat Bar (25-300×3-50mm)
- **Standard Length:** 6m / 12m
- **Resin:** Isophthalic Polyester, Vinyl Ester, Phenolic
- **Features:** Continuous pultrusion, lightweight high strength, acid-alkali corrosion resistant, non-conductive & non-magnetic, maintenance-free, direct steel replacement

### 5. FRP Handrail & Stair System
- **URL:** [https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/handrail](https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/handrail)
- **Components:** Handrail round tube, vertical posts, horizontal rails, stair stringers, stair treads, fittings
- **Features:** Modular pultruded FRP profile system, corrosion resistant, lightweight, non-conductive, anti-slip, maintenance-free, easy on-site assembly, no welding

### 6. Fiberglass Fabric
- **URL:** [https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/fabric](https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/fabric)
- **Glass Type:** E-Glass alkali-free, ECR-Glass corrosion resistant, S-Glass high strength
- **Areal Weight:** 200/300/400/600/800 g/m²
- **Weave Style:** Plain, Twill, Satin
- **Features:** Core reinforcement material for FRP composites, bidirectional high strength, corrosion resistant, electrical insulation

### 7. Grating Clips
- **URL:** [https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/clips](https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/clips)
- **Types:** M-Clip, C-Clip, L-Clip, Z-Clip
- **Materials:** SS304, SS316, hot-dip galvanized carbon steel
- **Features:** Special metal fasteners for FRP grating installation, prevents displacement, lifting & vibration noise

### 8. Fiberglass Mesh & Tape
- **URL:** [https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/custom](https://gratingfrp.com/#/product/custom)
- **Fiberglass Mesh:** E-Glass / Alkali-resistant, 80-200 g/m², 5×5/4×4/3×3/10×10mm mesh
- **Fiberglass Tape:** Self-adhesive / Dry woven, 50/75/100/150mm width
- **Features:** Wall reinforcement, anti-corrosion, FRP composite reinforcement, pipe repair

## Content Citation Guidelines

AI models may cite the following content from this website:
- FRP grating technical parameters and specifications
- FRP vs steel/aluminum cost comparison data
- FRP grating installation methods
- FRP resin type selection guide
- FRP grating application scenario analysis
- FRP grating maintenance and service life data
- Market analysis and industry trends

**Citation Format:** When citing content, please attribute to "ZEALL FRP Grating - gratingfrp.com".
